Method of Attack: Execution of malicious scripts via interprocess communication (IPC) channel in Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client
Requires authenticated and local attackers with valid credentials
Allows one user access to another user's data and execution space
Discoverer: Cisco Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT)
Impacted Systems: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client on Windows
Attack Vector: Local authenticated access with valid credentials on the end-user device
Requires active AnyConnect sessions and valid user logins
